song_title: Everything Is Art & WhoMadeWho - All The Love (radio edit)
thesis: Present a warm artful club narrative where intimate restraint and cinematic expansion trade off to embody “all the love” as both personal and communal space.

artist_branding.summary: WhoMadeWho-associated aesthetics typically emphasize emotive art-house electronic storytelling: elegant minimal foundations, human vocal texture, and carefully staged crescendos with premium cinematic polish.
visual_cues: Artful minimal openings that prioritize atmosphere and emotional clarity
Warm-meets-cool palette interplay with refined saturation control
Intentional pacing where large moments are earned through restraint
do_not_copy: Avoid direct imitation of signature scenography, video installations, or specific festival production identities tied to the artists.

motifs: Geometry motif: alternating intimate center states and wide inclusive arcs
Color motif: muted nocturnal base opening into warm amber, blush, and soft white affirmations
Movement motif: measured phrase breathing punctuated by emotionally timed expansions

visual_direction.color_story: Hold restrained dark-cool tones early, then progressively fold in warm amber and soft white for connective chorus statements.
visual_direction.motion_story: Use smooth medium-length transitions for narrative coherence, with selected high-energy phrases receiving tighter rhythmic travel.
visual_direction.staging_story: Let PAR fields establish emotional bed and use movers as expressive call-and-response voices that widen on communal payoff moments.

must_include: At least one intentionally intimate low-density section before major expansion
Visible warm-emotion payoff moments aligned to title/hook intent
Phrase-aware technique planning with explicit section contrast
avoid: Relentless maximal intensity that removes emotional contour
Harsh strobe-forward treatment across vocal-driven passages
Incoherent per-bar motif resets that undermine cinematic flow
